note: Main user journeys visible in the code. This is an anonymous, unauthenticated marketing site, so every flow is performed by a visitor; there are no logged-in / multi-step account journeys.

flows.name: Submit a contact inquiry (lead capture)
flows.note: Visitor fills the Contact form → client-side validation (required Contact Person/Company/Email + email pattern) → POST JSON to Web3Forms → 'Inquiry Received' success state on success, or an inline error message on API/network failure while the form stays editable.

flows.name: Contact via WhatsApp
flows.note: Visitor clicks 'Chat on WhatsApp' → opens a prefilled wa.me conversation (hard-coded number + message) in a new tab as an alternative to the form.

flows.name: Navigate the site via section anchors
flows.note: Visitor uses navbar links / logo / CTAs (desktop) or the hamburger overlay menu (mobile/tablet) to smooth-scroll between the anchored sections (About, Services, Methodology, Products, Market, Contact).

flows.name: Cinematic scroll-through experience
flows.note: Loading overlay dismisses once the Services frame asset is ready and 2.5s elapsed → visitor scrolls down through Hero fade/scale → Services scroll-scrubbed 86-frame animation with text-slide swap → Methodology staged parallax points → the rest of the page.

flows.name: Recover from a render error
flows.note: If a render-time error is thrown, the ErrorBoundary catches it and shows the 'System Interruption' fallback; the visitor clicks 'Restart Protocols' to reload the page.
